title: Lenovo's "30-Hour" Laptop Has ONLY 8GB RAM 😬
description:
Lenovo's new laptop claims 30 hours of battery — but the US model only comes with 8GB of RAM. 😬

The IdeaPad Slim 5 Ultra (14IWC11) just landed in the US at $1,149: Intel Core 5 315, 8GB RAM, 512GB SSD, a 14-inch 1200p OLED screen (300 nits, 60 Hz), a 65 Wh battery and about 1.06 kg (2.3 lb). The catch: other countries can get 16GB, and the 30-hour figure is Lenovo's local video playback test at 150 nits — its MobileMark 30 office test says 18.4 hours.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 51/100 → WRECK, unless battery life is all you need.
